svg.aria-label: Constructed spectra and executed fits. The target uses the NIST Ca II air wavelength 317.9332 nm; the second peak is constructed, with 0.018 nm separation and common FWHM 0.014 nm. Noise SD is 20 a.u.; the residual band spans ±40 a.u. Panel D uses the condition number of two normalized peak columns after constant/linear-background projection.
